# mxroute_catch_all (Resource)

Manage the existing domain catch-all singleton. Create applies the desired setting; import adopts it. Destroy only relinquishes Terraform management and PRESERVES the remote routing setting, including any forwarding address. No reset or delete API exists. Use one owner per domain; switching modes must omit address for fail/blackhole.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mxroute_catch_all" "routing" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  type    = "address"
  address = "unmatched@example.net"
  # For fail/blackhole, omit address.
  # Removing this resource preserves the remote setting.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain. Changing it relinquishes the old setting and manages the new domain's setting.
- `type` (String) fail (reject), blackhole (discard), or address (forward).

### Optional

- `address` (String) Email destination, required only for type address; omit for fail/blackhole. Non-address modes clear stale address from state.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional server description.
- `id` (String) Account-relative domain identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_catch_all.routing example.com
```
